Since we have a repeated eigenvalue $\lambda =-3$ (of multiplicity two) and only one corresponding eigenvector $v,$ the solution of the system is given by

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}v{e}^{\lambda t}+{c}_{2}(vt{e}^{\lambda t}+w{e}^{\lambda t}\,),
$$

where $w$ is a solution to the equation $(A-\lambda I)w=v.$

In our case, 

$$
\lambda =-3,\,v=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,w=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

 
Thus, the general solution of the system is

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x(t) \\ y(t)\end{aligned}] & ={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]{e}^{-3t}+{c}_{2}([\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]t{e}^{-3t}+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{-3t}) \\  & ={c}_{1}{e}^{-3t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}{e}^{-3t}[\begin{aligned}t \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.\end{aligned}
$$

The straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{1}{e}^{-3t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$
lie on the $x\text{-axis}.$ Since ${e}^{-3t}\to 0$ as $t\to \infty ,$ these solutions approach $\text{the origin}$ as $t\to \infty .$

Let's add the solutions to the phase space.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/8dc90697da27e52e0c1818d5529247d132944f30603936bedc191c4a14cb7d9c.png)

Now, consider solutions of the form
${c}_{2}{e}^{-3t}[\begin{aligned}t \\ 1\end{aligned}].$
When ${c}_{2}=1,$ we get the following curve:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=t{e}^{-3t} \\ y={e}^{-3t}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Computing the coordinates (rounded to two decimal places) of several points on the curve, we get the table below.

| $t$ | $-0.5$ | $0$ | $0.5$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $-2.24$ | $0$ | $0.11$ |
| $y$ | $4.48$ | $1$ | $0.22$ |

Let's add the solutions to the phase space.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/3981c3c5bdfc66850798ee3c34031acb0d1cdfea7181eb34a0a0422b44cc2ef0.png)

The phase portrait of our system looks as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069697/assets/f2b5b95167b1ecd07aa1152aeac6dd454fbe71ba953b05c4da22d8c36f76277a.png)
